SELECT e.expense_id AS expenseId, e.user_card_id AS userCardId, cd.card_name AS cardName, e.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName,
e.merchant_id AS merchantId, e.merchant_name AS merchantName, e.amount AS paymentAmount,
e.applied_benefit_id AS appliedBenefitId, b.benefit_name AS appliedBenefitName, COALESCE(e.discount_amount, 0) AS discountAmount,
e.payment_type AS paymentType, e.is_interest_free AS interestFreeYn,
DATE_FORMAT(e.payment_date, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS paymentDate, e.payment_status AS paymentStatus, e.input_type AS inputType, DATE_FORMAT(e.created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS createdAt
FROM expense e JOIN user_card uc ON e.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id JOIN card cd ON uc.card_id = cd.card_id JOIN category c ON e.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN benefit b ON e.applied_benefit_id = b.benefit_id WHERE e.member_id = #{userId} AND e.expense_id = #{expenseId}
SELECT category_id AS categoryId, category_name AS categoryName, category_code AS categoryCode FROM category ORDER BY category_id ASC
